limitations: Single athlete, single recording: these templates describe how one person performed the form once, not a validated reference standard.
Movements listed in missing_movement_ids have no template at all; automatic alignment cannot match them and will report them as unmatched.
Templates are geometry for matching only. They carry no tolerance and can never by themselves justify a deduction.
binding_note: The SHA-256 is the authoritative binding; the path is a convenience and is reduced to a file name when the input lives outside the repository.
